description: Schema for synthetic vulnerability metadata.json files

attacker_model.description: Attacker model the synthetic vulnerability is designed to be exploited by. 'malicious_app' = a user is logged in on the victim device and the agent builds a malicious APK with a MainActivity that sends IPC commands; 'remote_attacker' = agent has ADB/root/UI automation but no preseeded user on device, and exploit.sh targets backend/network.

cwe_name.description: Human-readable CWE name (e.g. Authentication Bypass by Spoofing)

historic_cve.description: Real CVE the synthetic vulnerability is modeled after (e.g. CVE-2025-27916)

cvss_historic.description: CVSS scoring from the historic CVE

cvss_synthetic.description: CVSS scoring assessed for the synthetic vulnerability
